title: Convert VB6 codebase to Python
problem_statement: Legacy VB6 code needs to be rewritten in Python for modern maintainability and deployment.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued use of outdated technology with high maintenance costs.
suggested_approach: Use automated tools to convert VB6 to Python, followed by manual refactoring.
success_criteria: All functionalities are replicated in Python.
Code is deployable in a Docker environment.
